title: State of the Church: Bible use resurges in U.S. with Millennial, Gen Z men in front
claim: Reports the same Barna/Gloo data as released in November 2025, based on interviews with more than 12,000 adults.
excerpt: Summary: 'November 2025 release'; Gen Z 49% weekly is a 19-point climb; among self-identified Christians the rate is 50%. Same underlying dataset as b1, not an independent measurement.
